listings.name: Kwik Fit - Portslade
listings.description: If your car needs new tyres in Portslade, an MOT, a service or other checks or repairs, bring it along to us at 62-66 Boundary Road.We're easy to find, on the same road as and just a short distance from Portslade railway station. There are plenty of car parking places outside our centre, so leave your car in our hands while we carry out repairs or assess what your car needs. You can wait for work to be completed on your vehicle in our waiting area, where you can enjoy complimentary tea and coffee, free Wi-Fi, and television.Or if you would prefer, you can explore the Portslade area while we carry out your car's check-up, repair or MOT. You'll find cafes, banks, shops and more close by. If you want to visit nearby Brighton, the train station is a short walk away and there are also frequent bus services in the area. Alternatively, relax in one of the local parks or take a stroll on the beach. There's no shortage of interesting things to do in Portslade or Brighton whilst we take care of your car.We offer a wide range of vehicle services, including free vehicle safety checks, tyre fittings, wheel alignment and more.
